hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *src/*.ts|*src/*.tsx|*worker/*.ts) out=$(npm run typecheck 2>&1) || { { echo "Typecheck FAILED after editing $f"; echo "$out" | grep -E 'error TS' | head -12; } >&2; exit 2; };; esac; }
hooks.rewakeMessage: The project no longer typechecks after your last edit. Fix it before moving on:
